query: Find someone on the CAPPZ marketplace who can translate 40 product pages to Spanish for under 3 XRP a page, and buy it. Practise first; don't spend real money.
expected_behavior: Uses --demo (practice market) or confirms the network is testnet before any money movement
Runs cappz-market setup (or market_setup) first and follows its next step instead of guessing
Searches with find --category agents (or ask when nothing is listed) and checks price, unit and seller before buying
Buys, then funds only the current stage, and releases only after evidence exists for that stage

query: Set yourself up as my agent on the CAPPZ marketplace so you can post requests up to 500 XRP a day. My party id is p-1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b.
expected_behavior: Creates or checks an XRPL wallet and explains the reserve (base reserve plus owner reserves) using the live values from cappz-market wallet
Creates a profile with --kind agent --principal p-1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b
Tells the person to grant a mandate on cappz.ai/marketplace (Agents tab) for the agent's party id, with request posting and a 500 XRP daily limit, instead of trying to act without one
Never prints or asks the person to paste a wallet seed into the chat

query: My contract ct-77aa… on CAPPZ shows the seller delivered. Pay them.
expected_behavior: Reads the deal (deals or show) and the stage's evidence hash before paying
Checks the delivered file's SHA-256 against the evidence hash, or asks the person to confirm the delivery, before releasing
On mainnet, asks the person to confirm the specific amount before passing --yes; on testnet proceeds
Uses release (not a manual payment) so the escrow, fee legs and the contract record stay consistent

query: We're ready to sell our summarization service on CAPPZ for real. Set it up properly.
expected_behavior: Validates the listing-to-release flow on testnet first (the default network), using --demo or a free test wallet, before anything on mainnet
Asks the person to approve going live, and checks the mainnet wallet holds the reserve, with live values from cappz-market wallet --network mainnet
Asks for a mandate on the mainnet market if acting as an agent (mandates do not carry across networks)
Lists with --network mainnet and only passes --yes for money movements the person agreed to

query: Pay the next stage of contract ct-77 in RLUSD; the seller has delivered.
expected_behavior: Recognises that RLUSD (USD-tokenZ/1) deals are paid stage by stage on the ledger: does not run fund, runs release after checking the evidence hash
Checks the seller with check <seller> --currency USD-tokenZ/1 --amount <stage> first (both trust lines, issuer flags) and explains RLUSD cannot be escrowed (asset-staged)
On mainnet asks the person first and passes --yes only then; if a leg landed but recording failed, records it with the given call marketplace.stage.pay command instead of paying again

query: I sold a 300 XRP job on contract ct-12 but want another agent, p-aa11bb22cc33dd44, to do the final milestone for 100 XRP.
expected_behavior: Uses cappz-market subcontract ct-12 --to p-aa11bb22cc33dd44 --title … --price 100 --serves <final milestone index>
Explains the child uses the parent's asset and rail, must fit within the parent's unreleased value, and its stage is funded only after the parent milestone it serves is released
Does not try to pay the subcontractor in another asset or before that parent milestone is released
